title: Storage
loadFailed: The storage overview could not be loaded.
description: Manage S3 storage profiles and migrate files safely between storages. A switch only happens after a complete copy, verification and controlled cutover.

toast.localRequested: Local S3 requested - the server will start it within a few minutes

confirm.deleteProfile: Delete profile “{name}”? Data stored in the bucket is not touched.
confirm.startInitial: Start the initial migration? hocX enters full maintenance and is locked for users until all files are copied and verified.
confirm.startLive: Start the live migration? hocX stays usable while copying.
confirm.cutover: Switch to the new storage? Writes are briefly locked, afterwards hocX works with the new storage.
confirm.pause: Pause the migration? Objects already copied are kept.
confirm.acceptMissing: Acknowledge objects that are already missing in the source? They are listed in the report and not transferred.
confirm.acknowledgeRollback: Confirm that you have reviewed the state? The new storage stays active; going back requires a new migration.
confirm.cancel: Cancel the migration in a controlled way? The source stays active, nothing is deleted.

banner.noCredentialsKey: STORAGE_CREDENTIALS_KEY is not set - S3 credentials cannot be stored securely.
banner.fenced: Writes are currently locked (cutover or maintenance).

profiles.title: Storage profiles
profiles.description: Credentials are stored encrypted and never shown again.

generations.title: Storage generations
generations.description: Every migration writes to a new generation. Superseded generations are kept until they are purged deliberately.

migration.title: {source} → {target}
migration.initialHint: Initial migration: hocX is in full maintenance during the migration.
migration.liveHint: Live migration: hocX stays usable, only the cutover briefly locks writes.
migration.confirmLive: Preflight passed. Expected copy duration: {range}, interruption during cutover: {cutover}.
migration.heartbeatStale: The storage worker no longer reports. Please check the storage-worker container - the migration resumes after it restarts.
migration.cutoverWithMissing: {count, plural, one {# database reference points to a missing file (see report). Cutover only after confirmation.} other {# database references point to missing files (see report). Cutover only after confirmation.}}
migration.cutoverReady: All objects are copied and verified. The cutover is waiting for your confirmation.
migration.rollbackRequired: The check after the cutover failed. The new storage is active; there is deliberately no automatic fallback. Please review the report and start a migration back if needed.

profileForm.locationLocked: The location of this profile is locked because it is active or still holds required data. Create a new profile and migrate to change the location.
profileForm.name: Display name
profileForm.endpointHelp: Leave empty for AWS; for Hetzner it is derived from the region.
profileForm.abgabeboxBucketHelp: Recommended: a separate bucket with its own restricted credentials.
profileForm.prefixHelp: Must not overlap with any other profile in the same bucket.
profileForm.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the stored credentials.
profileForm.restrictedHelp: The publicly reachable submission box uses these credentials. Without them it uses the main credentials.

startForm.title: Prepare migration
startForm.initialHint: Initial migration from the file system: after you confirm the start, hocX enters full maintenance until all files are copied and verified.
startForm.liveHint: Live migration: hocX stays usable while copying. Changes are caught up continuously.
startForm.needsTest: This profile needs a successful connection test first.
startForm.autoCutover: Switch over automatically after successful verification
startForm.nextStep: A preflight with a time estimate runs first. The migration only starts after your confirmation.

purge.title: Purge generation {generation}
purge.warning: Permanently deletes the data of this generation in profile “{profile}”. The active generation is not affected.
purge.label: Type “{expected}” to confirm
